description: Compose the study document and return it: structuredContent.usda is the root layer's text, name its file name, layers every layer (name, usda). The caller writes them into its own studies directory; the court writes nothing. A Franklin avatar prompt composes the guidance stage. An Iliad scene 02 prompt composes the plague cut. An Iliad scene 01 prompt bakes the native companion from example_usda, or NAMES the shipped companion when none is sent. Other study prompts compose the edit list.

example_usda.description: optional: the text of iliad-01-scene-01-imax.usda, for an Iliad scene 01 prompt that wants the native companion baked. Without it the court answers NAMED with the shipped companion's name.

prompt.description: the person's words. Iliad selects the Iliad cut. Franklin avatar composes the next avatar stage.

study.description: the study that owns the document, e.g. study-51 or franklin-avatar

name: study_usda
